change_log.old: de.etl → de.loading only (linear E→T→L→ETL chain tip)
change_log.reason: ETL is the composition of extract, transform, and load—not a topic that only presupposes Loading
change_log.rationale: Direct-prerequisite semantics: understanding ETL requires all three stages as components, not a single terminal step.

change_log.new: removed; warehouses no longer require star schema
change_log.reason: A warehouse is an analytical store; star schema is one modeling pattern, not a hard prerequisite of warehouses
change_log.rationale: Curriculum-order coupling (star before warehouse) was not direct prerequisite semantics.

change_log.reason: Star schemas are typically realized as warehouse schemas
change_log.rationale: Direct: star schema design presupposes dimensional modeling and a warehouse target for facts/dimensions.

change_log.reason: Batch pipelines are a scheduling/execution pattern broader than ETL; ETL may use batch but batch does not require ETL
change_log.rationale: Avoided forcing Batch through ETL (curriculum packaging). Batch presupposes sources to process.

change_log.reason: Warehousing practice directly includes dimensional modeling, not only stores and batch jobs
change_log.rationale: Data Warehousing as overview requires the store, the modeling approach, and batch movement patterns.

change_log.reason: Freshness is defined relative to source update timing
change_log.rationale: Direct: freshness SLAs compare pipeline outputs to Source Systems.

change_log.reason: Facts/dimensions are schema designs over typed attributes
change_log.rationale: Dimensional modeling presupposes declared Schemas as the medium of design.

change_log.old: brief stage definitions without stated presuppositions
change_log.new: descriptions name direct prerequisites and discourage reverse stage edges
change_log.reason: Dependency generation sees descriptions; v1 saw frequent Extraction↔Transformation direction errors
change_log.rationale: Explicit 'directly requires' wording clarifies stage direction without changing dependency architecture.

change_log.old: warehouses nested under star schema under dimensional modeling
change_log.new: warehouses as store concept; star schema as modeling pattern atop warehouses + dimensional modeling
change_log.reason: Mixed store vs modeling abstraction in one chain
change_log.rationale: Separates analytical storage from schema pattern so prerequisites stay direct.

review_notes: v2 focuses on direct ETL composition edges, decouples warehouses from star-schema curriculum order, and clarifies batch vs ETL abstraction.

concepts.title: Source Systems
concepts.description: Operational systems that produce data to be integrated. Foundational producers; extraction and freshness are defined relative to these systems.

concepts.title: Extraction
concepts.description: Reading data out of source systems for downstream processing. Directly requires Source Systems. Transformation depends on Extraction, not the reverse.

concepts.title: Transformation
concepts.description: Cleaning, joining, and reshaping already-extracted data. Directly requires Extraction; you transform extracts, you do not extract after transforming.

concepts.title: Loading
concepts.description: Writing transformed data into a target store. Directly requires Transformation; loading presupposes cleaned/reshaped records.

concepts.title: ETL
concepts.description: Extract-Transform-Load as a composed pipeline pattern. Directly requires Extraction, Transformation, and Loading as its three stages—not merely the final load step.

concepts.title: Schemas
concepts.description: Declared structure and types for datasets and tables. Foundational for validation and dimensional modeling.

concepts.title: Dimensional Modeling
concepts.description: Modeling analytics data with facts and dimensions. Directly requires Schemas as the medium for typed fact/dimension attributes.

concepts.title: Warehouses
concepts.description: Central analytical stores optimized for reporting workloads. Store concept; does not require star schema (star schema is a modeling pattern used inside warehouses).

concepts.title: Star Schema
concepts.description: Fact table surrounded by denormalized dimension tables. Directly requires Dimensional Modeling and Warehouses as the usual target store.

concepts.title: Batch Pipelines
concepts.description: Scheduled jobs that process finite data windows from sources. Directly requires Source Systems; batch is an execution pattern and does not presuppose ETL specifically.

concepts.title: Data Warehousing
concepts.description: Practices for modeling and operating analytical warehouses. Directly requires Warehouses, Dimensional Modeling, and Batch Pipelines.

concepts.title: Validation
concepts.description: Checking records against schema and business rules. Directly requires Schemas. Validation is an input to quality tests, not a substitute for Data Quality as a whole.

concepts.title: Freshness
concepts.description: How up-to-date a dataset is relative to its sources. Directly requires Source Systems against which freshness is measured.

concepts.title: Data Tests
concepts.description: Automated assertions over pipeline outputs and invariants. Directly requires Validation and Freshness as primary quality dimensions under test.

concepts.title: Data Quality
concepts.description: Fitness of data for intended use. Directly requires Data Tests as the operational mechanism; Validation alone is not the full quality practice.
